title: Notify every reachable customer of a planned outage

blocks.text: Before planned maintenance, `OutageNotifier` tells the customers of a region, by every channel they gave us. Two complaints came in after the last outage: the mail gateway rejected a batch because one of its addresses was `null`, and customers were woken at night although they had set quiet hours.

items: `contacts(segment)`: each customer's email, then phone, customer by customer. Either may be missing. The CRM returns `null`, not an empty list, for a region with no customers;
`isQuietHour(quietHours, hour)`: whether `hour` is one of the customer's quiet hours.

blocks.text: About five lines in total. When you're done, nothing `null` reaches the gateway, an empty region sends nothing without failing, and nobody hears from us during their quiet hours.

cases.says: a segment's contacts are each customer's email then phone, customer by customer
an hour that is not among a customer's quiet hours is not quiet
a customer with no email or no phone contributes only the contacts they have, and no null
a segment the CRM returned as null has no contacts instead of failing
an hour listed among the customer's quiet hours is recognised, so no notice goes out then

origin.section: Stream.of Streams Its Arguments: an int[] Is One Element, and So Is null

concepts: Stream.of on an int[] is a stream of one element, the array; Arrays.stream or IntStream.of streams the values.
Stream.of(x) with x null holds one null, while Stream.ofNullable(x) is empty for null.
